component.name: Cairn
component.summary: Extract Diablo II: Resurrected's data files for faster loading

description.p: Diablo II: Resurrected reads its art, sound and data out of compressed archives every time it loads a zone. Unpacking them to plain files means the game stops decompressing and starts reading, which is where the loading time goes.

Cairn extracts those archives and keeps a record of every file it writes. That record is what lets a game patch be applied as an update — only the files that changed are rewritten — and what lets Undo remove exactly the files Cairn created, leaving anything you put in the same folder alone.
After extracting, add -direct -txt to the game's launch options. Without those flags the game ignores the files entirely.

ul.li: Reads both Battle.net's CASC storage and Steam's newer static-container format
Updates only what a patch changed, using the archives' own content keys
Undo removes only what Cairn wrote, and prunes the folders it emptied
Several destinations, so a mods folder stays in step with the game folder
Optional localised audio and text, in place of the English files
Finds installations automatically, including inside a Proton prefix

description.p: First release: extract, update, undo, destinations, and localised files.
